feeds.title: Douvris Martial Arts
feeds.description: We continue to post articles here that cover topics related to Karate, Martial Arts, Kickboxing, and related topics that we feel strongly about. At DOUVRIS martial arts Ottawa, We are devoted to cultivating the practice of karate Ottawa, supporting the pursuit of fitness, fostering kinship, and developing leadership among people of all ages.

feeds.title: Bushido Martial Arts Blog
feeds.description: Bushido Martial Arts were established in 1994 and have become Canada's largest martial arts equipment manufacturer and supplier. Your best choice martial arts and fight gear supplier ensures you can perform your best through our quality customer service and products.

feeds.title: Legends MMA Blog
feeds.description: Legends MMA prides itself in specializing in mixed martial arts for men, women, and children. Whether it is to learn self defense, get in shape, stay active, lose weight or live out that dream of being a fighter, we have classes and training regimens for all levels.

feeds.title: Martial Arts Toronto Blog
feeds.description: Martial Arts Toronto is a group of affiliated dojo in the Downtown/Midtown area of Toronto under the guidance and leadership of Sensei Patrice Williams, 7th Dan. As his students, the dojo directors keep the curriculum, training methods, and standards consistent across all dojo. This creates the opportunity for students to gather from various dojo to train in seminars, or in certain circumstances to attend classes at other dojos while receiving a unified training experience.

feeds.title: Posener's Pankration Blog
feeds.description: Posener's Pankration's mission Statement since 1989 is to bring out the best physically, mentally, and spiritually in our students and in ourselves in the long term through martial arts.

feeds.title: Northern Karate Schools Blog
feeds.description: Northern Karate Schools exercise-with-a-purpose is an ideal way for adults to get and stay in shape as they acquire personal protection skills. NKS training helps students develop strength, flexibility, and cardiovascular fitness challenges your mind and is moving meditation.

feeds.title: Mississauga Elite Training Centre
feeds.description: Welcome to Mississauga's Home for Martial Arts and Fitness Excellence. Specialising in Muay Thai, BJJ, Fitness & MMA training for all experience levels.

feeds.title: Academy Of Martial Arts Blog
feeds.description: We are a martial arts school in your neighborhood and have been for 30 years. It's all about our kids; Their personal self development, self discipline and confidence is important us.

feeds.title: Arashi Do
feeds.description: Learn more about our methods, instructors, and the benefits of martial arts for children and adults by reading our blog posts. In 1985, Kyoshi Mike Bonde and Kyoshi Gary Vig started Arashi-Do with the goal of creating a family of skilled martial artists. Arashi-Do now offers programs in Karate, Muay Thai Kickboxing, and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.

feeds.title: Chang's Tae Kwon Do Blog
feeds.description: Chang's Tae Kwon Do Martial Arts offers something for everyone in a fun and supportive, friendly environment. Martial Arts is for the whole family and of all ages. At Chang's TaeKwonDo Martial Arts, we bring you the most unique, energy-filled, unforgettable experience in your life.

feeds.title: Contact Kicks Blog
feeds.description: Follow our Blog for great articles, announcements, tips, and tricks. Founded by Steve and Mici, Contact Kicks is your place to learn and train training in Martial Arts is that it can be practiced anywhere and anytime.

feeds.title: Infighting
feeds.description: Helping you become the best version of yourself, our blog is a free online training resource for Kickboxing, BJJ, and fitness! Infighting is for Absolute Beginners, Martial Artists, Athletes, and Kids. The exercises are simple and effective and anyone of any fitness level can participate!

feeds.title: Jiu Jitsu Marketplace Blog
feeds.description: Jiu-Jitsu Marketplace was founded in 2018 by two digital geeks who have been passionate about the art of jiu-jitsu for nearly a decade. Our mission is to provide consumers with high-quality jiu-jitsu apparel, with designs that are aesthetically pleasing, culturally relevant, entertaining, funny, shocking, and thought-provoking.

feeds.title: AMA Dojo Blog
feeds.description: AMA Dojo KARATE Makes Everything Better. After 25 years of teaching and learning, the Academy of Martial Arts offers the highest quality of self-defense training, tailoring the martial arts to each student's personal goals, in and out of the classroom. The Academy of Martial Arts promotes positive change, both external and internal. Students learn focus, managing and accomplishing goals, understanding personal strengths and weaknesses, and push themselves to be better.

feeds.title: Kazoku Martial Arts Blog
feeds.description: Kazoku Martial Arts is an institution dedicated to the growth and development of its students. We strive to create a family-oriented culture so everybody feels welcome. Our mission is to create active leaders within our community and to provide a diverse, inclusive, positive space in Cambridge.

feeds.title: Ottawa Academy of Martial Arts Blog
feeds.description: Read our resourceful and entertaining Ottawa martial arts blog posts written by the team at Ottawa Academy of Martial Arts. Our structured classes are meant to help develop coordination, physical fitness, mental strength, as well as gain valuable social skills. Learn self-defense, build confidence, and get in the best shape of your lives!

feeds.title: Limitless Martial Arts Inc.
feeds.description: Our mission to 'Cultivate Community Leaders' derives from our passion to advocate the martial arts to our community. We teach our students the value of respect, self-control, and discipline and guide them towards a journey of self-mastery. We believe that martial arts are a powerful outlet and platform to empower young people in developing a healthy self-image, self-confidence and wisely choosing good social groups.

feeds.title: The Academy of Martial Arts
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Bill Fraser and I'm the head coach of the Comox Valley area's premier MMA and fitness training academy. Comox Valley Martial Arts is home to a welcome positive and fun atmosphere made up of people from all walks of life. Doesn't matter if you are an MMA competitor, fitness enthusiast, or someone looking to build their knowledge in the martial arts, we will help you reach your goals and promise you will have a great time doing it.

feeds.title: Aikido Durham Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Aikido Durham! Our martial arts school in Whitby Ontario is home for students of Aikido and meditation alike. For martial artists, we provide authentic Japanese martial arts training for adults and teens. Additionally, we provide open guided meditation. Our blog will be updated regularly with thoughts on martial arts and meditation concepts.

feeds.title: Ogawa Martial Arts Blog
feeds.description: After years of teaching martial arts in the GTA, Kate Cowan began Ogawa Club as Ogawa Family Karate after moving to Ridgeway, Ontario. Our roots are humble: we opened first in a local church, operating 4 days per week offering only classes in Traditional Karate.

feeds.title: Northstar Tai Chi Chuan
feeds.description: ​Northstar Tai Chi Chuan, led by instructor Jay Soderberg, offers comprehensive training in Tai Chi Chuan, Qigong, and meditation in the Minneapolis area. With over 15 years of experience since 2006, Jay has studied various Yang style forms, including the traditional Long Form (108 moves), the 24-Form, Cheng Man Ching's 37-Form, and the 40-Form.

feeds.title: Dragon Taekwondo Academy Milton Blog
feeds.description: Read our resourceful and entertaining Dragon Taekwondo blog posts written by the martial arts experts at Dragon Taekwondo Academy. Since 2010 we have been working with and developing students of all ages in achieving their individual goals. At Dragon Taekwondo we teach students 'real-life lessons' such as 'hard work pays off and you will not get a participation medal for just showing up.'

feeds.title: Apex Martial Arts Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2008, Apex has grown to be one of the most successful academies in the Metro Vancouver area. Our instructors provide quality coaching in Kickboxing and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu programs. We constantly evaluate our teaching methods and programs, to ensure continuous improvement.
